Q8245.reason: The absolute threshold is the intensity detected 50% of the time; 15 of 30 mice (50%) responded at 70% power, while 80% and 60% gave 67% and 33%.

Q8128.reason: Exercise-induced cough and nasal symptoms in a young person with an asthmatic sibling point to asthma, and normal spirometry between episodes does not exclude it.

Q5479.reason: The wife's solicitation was complete when she offered payment to kill, and her later renunciation came after she feared prosecution, so it is not a voluntary defense; conspiracy fails because the agent never truly agreed.
